description: A script to safely clean the Next.js cache directories and ensure certain directories exist, implemented in Node.js using the 'fs', 'path', and 'url' modules. It removes specified cache directories and creates necessary directories to prevent errors in certain environments.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Outputs a message to stdout with a newline.
